100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 19, 1926, the world is abuzz with notable developments. In Germany, political tensions rise as the Reichstag debates the ongoing economic crisis, prompting concerns over stability in the Weimar Republic. Meanwhile, in Egypt, King Fuad I faces growing nationalist sentiments as protests against British influence intensify. Across the Atlantic, American cinema continues to flourish, with the silent film industry facing challenges from the advent of sound technology.
